//: The tsconfig `next build` uses, which is NOT the one the repo type-checks with.
`next build` runs the project's type-check, and from Next 16 that covers every
file the tsconfig includes rather than only what the app imports. The backend
image is built from a context that excludes `e2e/` (see .dockerignore), so
`e2eTotpParity.test.ts` — which deliberately imports the e2e suite's TOTP
helper to check it against the backend's — stopped resolving and failed the
image build on dev for every commit after the Next 16 upgrade. The tests
themselves were fine; nothing about them is shipped.
So the production build checks what it ships, and `make type-check` still
checks everything from tsconfig.json, including the tests and the e2e import
that is the whole point of that file.
